_comment: The approved-video list. This file IS the parental control: the app shows
exactly what is in here and has no way to reach anything else.
To add a video, take the 11-character id from its URL —
then push to main. The git-connected Cloudflare build redeploys the Worker
and every device picks the change up the next time its grid is opened.
Check each id by opening https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=<id> yourself
before adding it. Nothing downstream validates that an id points at what
you meant — only that it is well-formed — so a typo is a real way to put
the wrong video in front of a child.
Entries whose id is not exactly 11 url-safe characters are dropped by the
app rather than shown, and so are duplicates.
